blocks.text: Jessica Sanchez was announced as one of the new inductees into the Asian Hall of Fame, joining the likes of Blackpink’s Rosé and Emmy Award-winning personalities Simran Baidwan and Frank Buckley. Sanchez is being honored for her victory as the reality talent competition “America’s Got Talent” season 20 champion. “During times of worldwide conflict, Asian Hall of Fame serves as a beacon of cross-cultural collaboration and interracial synergy. Class of 2026 Inductees and Goodwill Ambassadors are role models whose endearing legacies advance culture, commerce, and community for generations to come,” said Maki Hsieh, president and CEO of Asian Hall of Fame, […]...
